changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla attempt_grants: intentos extra habilitados por el instructor para un paso o para la evaluación final. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría attempt_grants_audit y el trigger attempt_grants_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Extra attempts granted by an instructor to a learner, for a path step or for the final assessment

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: path_step_id
column.remarks: Path step that receives the attempts; null for the final assessment

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment that receives the attempts for the final assessment

column.name: note
column.remarks: Reason or note of the grant

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE attempt_grants ADD CONSTRAINT attempt_grants_target_ck CHECK (num_nonnulls(path_step_id, enrollment_id) = 1)
ALTER TABLE attempt_grants ADD CONSTRAINT attempt_grants_attempts_ck CHECK (attempts >= 1)
CREATE TRIGGER attempt_grants_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON attempt_grants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in attempt_grants

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE attempt_grants_audit ADD CONSTRAINT attempt_grants_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER attempt_grants_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON attempt_grants FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS attempt_grants_audit_trg ON attempt_grants
